title: Heisenberg's team calculates the fissile material used in the Hiroshima bomb

tellings.quote: >> Yeah. They overheard these guys. They have that, you know, transcript of how immediately Heisenberg and his people calculated the amount of file material used.

plain: In 1945, while German atomic scientists were being held at a house in the English countryside, they were secretly overheard, and a transcript shows how quickly the physicist Werner Heisenberg and his team worked out the amount of fissile material, the nuclear fuel, in the bomb dropped on Hiroshima. The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells Michels this without naming a source, citing only a wiretap transcript. He brings it up to suggest the Germans knew far more about the bomb than they let on.
